_doc: Exceptions to the AGPL-3.0 compatibility policy (SPEC-v3 V7). Every entry needs kind, name, scope and a non-empty reason; an entry without them is itself an audit failure. scope: "distributed" (shipped by LectureFlow) or "user-fetched" (only for whole Python packages of the component lock files: downloaded by the component manager on the user's computer from PyPI or a mirror, never distributed by LectureFlow; listed in their own section of THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Optional: version (else any), file (accept only that unrecognised license/notice file), license (license to show). Do not add an entry just to make the audit pass.

entries.name: modernc.org/memory
entries.reason: The file only names the Wikimedia Commons source of the project logo image; the logo is not part of the Go code compiled into LectureFlow.

entries.name: av
entries.reason: Not distributed with LectureFlow: not in the installer or any LectureFlow download; the component manager downloads it on the user's computer from PyPI (or the mirror the user chose), pinned by the component lock file, into the component's own Python environment that runs in a separate process. The project must not publish offline component archives that contain this package. Incompatibility: the Windows wheel bundles OpenSSL 1.1 libcrypto (OpenSSL/SSLeay license, GPL-incompatible) next to an FFmpeg built with GPL parts (libx264, libx265). Component: asr-cuda. Lead ruling 2026-10-24. LectureFlow's combination with this package is covered by the additional permission under AGPL-3.0 section 7 in LICENSE-EXCEPTION.md (user decision 2026-10-25), which names it; that permission does not change this package's own license and does not change the rule above: LectureFlow still does not distribute it.
